# ProvenMap plugins

Map your codebase onto a living architecture board in [ProvenMap](https://provenmap.com), straight
from your AI coding host. The plugins analyse the code locally, classify every component against
your workspace's archetypes, map how they connect, and sync the result to a board your team can
review, question and plan work on.

| Plugin                  | Install id       | For        | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | ---------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **ProvenMap Code**      | `pmap-code`      | Developers | Binds one repo to one board, maps the codebase locally (`/analyze`) and pushes it (`/sync`). Also grounds a board in the repo's documents (`/ground`), surfaces insights (`/discover`) and delivers work items (`/work-items`). |
| **ProvenMap Architect** | `pmap-architect` | Architects | Works over the whole workspace through the ProvenMap MCP server: sets up the system landscape, plans new apps, authors work items and playbooks. Binds no repo.                                                              |

ProvenMap Code reads JavaScript/TypeScript (with Vue and Svelte), Python, Java, Go, C# (with
Razor), Ruby, Rust, PHP, Kotlin, Swift and Scala, plus Protobuf contracts.

> [!NOTE]
> **ProvenMap Connect (`pmap-connect`) is retired.** Its grounding moved into ProvenMap Code as
> `/ground`, which picks up the same `.provenmap/` state. If you have it installed, install
> `pmap-code` and uninstall `pmap-connect`.

## Install

| Host                                | ProvenMap Code | ProvenMap Architect |
| ----------------------------------- | :------------: | :-----------------: |
| **Claude Code** / **Claude Cowork** |       ✅       |         ✅          |
| **Codex**                           |       ✅       |         ✅          |
| **Cursor**                          |       ✅       |          —          |

**Claude Code**

```bash
/plugin marketplace add provenmap/pmap-claude
/plugin install pmap-code@provenmap
/plugin install pmap-architect@provenmap
```

Restart Claude Code so the commands load.

**Codex**

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add provenmap/pmap-codex
codex plugin add pmap-code@provenmap
codex plugin add pmap-architect@provenmap
```

Start a new Codex thread so the commands load.

**Cursor** installs ProvenMap Code locally into `~/.cursor/plugins/local/`, then adds its MCP
server with the "Add to Cursor" link on [provenmap.com](https://provenmap.com).

Install only the plugins you need. When both are installed, use the plugin-qualified command name
if two collide: `/pmap-code:login`, `/pmap-architect:login`.

## Get started

In a repo you want on a board:

```bash
/login       # sign in in the browser and pick the board for this repo
/analyze     # map the codebase locally, into .provenmap/
/sync        # push it to the board
```

Unsure what to run next? **`/start`** reads the project's real state and tells you, and **`/help`**
lists every command with the plugin version. For ProvenMap Architect, run `/login` and then
`/setup-workspace` on an empty workspace, or `/start` on one that already has boards.

Full documentation:

- [Getting started with the plugins](https://provenmap.com/docs/getting-started/plugin-quick-start)
- [The code plugin](https://provenmap.com/docs/sources/code-plugin): every command, flag and setting
- [The architect workbench](https://provenmap.com/docs/platform-features/architect-workbench)

## Credentials and data

- **ProvenMap Code** keeps its credentials in `.provenmap/credentials.json` and its settings in
  `.provenmap/config.json`. `/login` writes both and adds `.provenmap/` to `.gitignore`. In CI,
  set `PMAP_BINDING_TOKEN` and `PMAP_API_SECRET` instead. Credentials are never echoed to the chat.
- **ProvenMap Architect** uses a workspace MCP token, stored by `/login` in your home directory
  (`~/.provenmap/`, owner-only), never in the project. `/logout` revokes it.
- Both talk only to `https://platform.provenmap.com/api`, or to the `baseUrl` you set for a
  self-hosted instance.
- **What `/sync` sends:** the board's nodes and edges with their names and descriptions, the
  repo's remote URL, branch and commit, and, by default, a source reference per element (its
  relative file path and a link to it on your git host). Set `"includeSourceReferences": false` in
  `.provenmap/config.json` to leave the paths out. `/analyze` never edits your source.

## Get help

- **Questions, ideas and board modelling:**
  [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/provenmap/community/discussions), the community home.
- **Bugs:** run `/report-bug`. It drafts a report with your project details removed, to post in
  the community or send to support.
- **Account, billing or anything private:** [support@provenmap.com](mailto:support@provenmap.com).
  Paid plans add direct support; see
  [Plans & Billing](https://provenmap.com/docs/reference-and-resources/plans-and-billing).
